Do you enjoy hands-on work and pay attention to detail? We are looking for an assembly worker for a production company in Lokeren that assembles car seats for Volvo Trucks. Experience in assembly or production is important, as well as accuracy, concentration and a practical attitude.
 

As a car seat assembly worker, you will work on a production line where car seats are assembled. Together with your colleagues, you will make sure that every component is fitted correctly and that the finished product meets the required quality standards.
 

Your responsibilities:
 
 

•  

Assemble car seat components on the production line.
  

•  

Carry out your part of the assembly process accurately.
  

•  

Check your work and make sure all components are assembled correctly.
  

•  

Regularly change workstations and help out at different stages of the production process.
  
 

•  

You have experience as an assembly worker or in a similar production role.
  

•  

You are physically fit and comfortable handling heavier components.
  

•  

You work accurately, stay focused and pay attention to quality.
  

•  

You have a good command of spoken and written English.

As a Customer Support Assistant, you will be responsible for delivering a smooth and professional customer experience from the first contact through to order delivery.
 
 

• Be the first point of contact for distributors and end users, handling questions, requests and issues in a professional and customer-oriented way. 

• Manage the complete order process, from order intake through logistics, including coordinating shipments and transport. 

• Provide high-quality customer support via phone, email and chat. 

• Follow up on customer requests and issues and ensure timely and effective resolution. 

• Keep customer information, interactions and issues accurately recorded in our CRM system. 

• Identify recurring customer issues and share insights with internal teams to help improve our products and services. 

• Proactively identify opportunities to improve our customer service processes and contribute to initiatives that make our way of working more efficient. 

• Work closely with colleagues across different teams to ensure a seamless customer experience. 

You are a customer-oriented and solution-focused person who enjoys taking ownership and working in a fast-paced environment.
 

You bring:
 
 

• Fluency in English and French, both written and spoken - this is essential. 

• A minimum of a Bachelor's degree is required. 

• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. 

• A structured and accurate way of working, with a strong eye for detail. 

• The ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks while maintaining a high level of service. 

• A proactive, positive and customer-centric mindset. 

• Previous experience in customer support, order administration or a similar role is a plus. 

• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is an advantage.

• The focus is on the Mechanical part: Mechanical adjustments and machine tuning.
• The Electrical part involves replacing sensors and real indept Electrical problems. 
• Supporting production and corrective maintenance
• Limited deep electrical troubleshooting (sensor replacement/settings adjustments).
• Shift hours: 05:00–13:00 / 13:00–21:00 / 21:00–05:00. You will change shifts weekly. 
• Early and late shift: 2 technicians on corrective maintenance + 1 on preventive maintenance
• Night shift: focused on corrective maintenance (reduced production crew)

Preferably you are an experienced technician. However, if you are a motivated junior looking for a long-term commitment and learning mindset we will also like to meet you! 

You are fluent in Dutch or English.

Ideally you live close to the site in Sint-niklaas.

jobs.occupation: Flexi Kitchen Assistant - Antwerp City Center
jobs.description:
Looking for a flexible kitchen job that fits 
your schedule?
 

Do you enjoy working with food, being part of a team and seeing guests enjoy dishes you've helped create? Whether you're already an experienced kitchen professional or taking your first steps into hospitality, we'd love to meet you.
 

For our busy restaurant in the heart of 
Antwerp city centre, we're looking for a 
Flexi Kitchen Assistant who can strengthen our kitchen team based on their own availability.
 

The best part? 
You decide how you work. Prefer fixed days every week? Great. Rather work different shifts depending on your schedule? That's perfectly fine too.
 

What will you be doing?
 

As part of our kitchen team, you'll help bring every dish to life:
 
 

• Assisting with the preparation of ingredients and dishes 

• Grilling and preparing meat and fish 

• Helping with the finishing and plating of dishes 

• Ensuring every plate looks as good as it tastes 

• Supporting your colleagues during service 

• Maintaining cleanliness and hygiene standards throughout the kitchen  

Our goal is simple: every plate leaves the kitchen looking irresistible and comes back completely empty.

Who are we looking for?
 
 

• You're motivated and eager to learn 

• You enjoy working as part of a team 

• You can stay focused, even during busy services 

• You have a good command of English 

• Additional languages are always a plus 

• Experience is welcome, but certainly not required  

Whether you've spent years behind the stove or can barely tell a whisk from a spatula, we'll provide the training you need to succeed.

Join our Global Support Network (Gsn) and help ensure the reliability and availability of our healthcare IT solutions used by customers around the world.

As a Senior Support Engineer / Domain Expert, you will solve complex technical problems in business-critical customer environments, working closely with regional support teams, Cloud Operations, Professional Services, Product Management, Quality, and R&D. You will combine deep technical troubleshooting with strong customer engagement and take ownership of issues through resolution.

Beyond resolving incidents, you will help us prevent them by identifying recurring problems, improving our monitoring and observability capabilities, sharing knowledge, and contributing to more proactive and predictive support.

What you'll do

 
• Solve complex technical problems:
  
   
• Diagnose and resolve complex incidents affecting enterprise healthcare IT solutions.
   
• Take end-to-end ownership of technical issues and drive them toward resolution.
   
• Analyze logs, metrics, diagnostics, and system behavior to identify root causes.
   
• Coordinate technical activities across teams during critical customer situations.
   
• Communicate findings, recommendations, and resolution plans clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
  
 
• Be a technical expert:
  
   
• Build and maintain deep expertise in our products, technologies, and solution architectures.
   
• Provide advanced technical guidance to support teams around the world.
   
• Work across enterprise applications, operating systems, databases, networking, integrations, cloud, and containerized environments.
   
• Collaborate with R&D and other specialists on challenging technical issues and escalations.
  
 
• Prevent tomorrow's incidents:
  
   
• Identify recurring issues, technical trends, and systemic problems and contribute to root cause analysis and corrective actions.
   
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our monitoring and observability platform, helping us identify emerging issues proactively, prevent incidents, and improve the reliability of our customers' environments.
   
• Turn lessons learned into technical documentation and reusable knowledge.
   
• Contribute ideas that improve product quality, support processes, automation, and operational efficiency.
  
 
• Help the team and our services grow:
  
   
• Share knowledge and mentor colleagues across our global support organization.
   
• Contribute to the operational readiness of new releases, upgrades, and customer deployments.
   
• Represent customer needs and operational experience when collaborating with Product Management, R&D, Quality, and other stakeholders.
   
• Explore opportunities to use automation and AI-assisted diagnostics to improve customer outcomes.
  

What will help you succeed

You enjoy solving difficult technical problems and are comfortable when the answer is not immediately obvious. You combine technical curiosity with a strong customer focus and

 
• Take ownership and follow problems through to resolution
 
• Communicate complex technical topics clearly
 
• Remain effective in high-pressure customer situations
 
• Collaborate well across teams, cultures, and geographies
 
• Enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others succeed
 
• Bring a continuous learning and improvement mindset

Fluent written and spoken English is required; additional languages are an advantage. A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, or a related discipline is preferred, although equivalent professional experience...

We are looking for someone with:

• 3 to 5 years of experience in technical customer support, enterprise software support, healthcare IT, or a comparable technical role.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, ideally gained in business-critical or mission-critical environments.

• A good understanding of enterprise application architectures, networking, operating systems, databases, and system integrations.

• Hands-on Kubernetes experience, including supporting and troubleshooting containerized applications and environments.

• Hands-on AWS experience, with practical knowledge of cloud infrastructure, networking, monitoring, and operations.

• Experience analyzing logs, metrics, diagnostics, and other technical data to isolate complex problems.

• Experience working directly with customers and managing technical escalations.

• Familiarity with ITSM and ITIL-based support processes.

• Experience with healthcare IT is an advantage, but not essential.

For our client in Beernem, we are looking for an experienced tiler.
 

You will join a young and dynamic team.
 

Be sure to apply if you are interested!
 

 
 

 

 
 

 
• You are a worker with several years of experience in tiling
 
• A driving licence is required!
 
• You speak fluent Dutch or English

• You will pick goods for the customer based on an order form. Accuracy and attention to detail are very important.

Opportunity

Hybrid (2 days on-site per week) · Permanent, full-time

About the role

You'll keep one or more defence software Squads moving, running ceremonies, clearing blockers, and turning Agile principles into daily practice, with senior Scrum Masters and Agile Coaches alongside you as you find your footing. This is a permanent role in a Spotify-inspired organisation (Squads, Chapters, Tribes), and the mentoring structure is a deliberate design feature, not a vague promise.

Your Mission

What you'll do

• Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, Retrospectives and Backlog Refinement, so your Squad leaves each session with clarity and a workable plan.
• Identify and remove impediments that slow delivery, escalating where needed and working with stakeholders to keep momentum.
• Partner with Market Product Managers on backlog refinement, sprint readiness and prioritisation so the Squad is always working on the right things.
• Collaborate with Tech Writers to make sure documentation is planned and aligned with sprint goals, not bolted on afterwards.
• Monitor team health and track Agile metrics, using what you learn to support continuous improvement in ways of working.
• Coordinate with other Scrum Masters, Chapters and stakeholders to surface and manage cross-Squad dependencies before they become blockers.
What success looks like

Over time, your Squads run ceremonies that feel purposeful rather than routine: the team arrives prepared, leaves aligned, and the retrospective actually changes something. Impediments get named early and resolved rather than accumulating. You start spotting dependency risks before they surface as problems, and your collaboration with Market Product Managers and Tech Writers becomes a natural part of the Squad rhythm rather than a coordination overhead.

 

What you bring

• Up to two years of experience in an Agile environment, as a Scrum Master, Project Coordinator, Business Analyst, QA or a comparable role where you worked alongside or within Agile ceremonies.
• Working knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles, conceptual fluency you can apply in a real Squad, not necessarily a certification.
• Facilitation and communication skills strong enough to keep a room moving and surface issues without creating friction.
• Organisational discipline to track dependencies and keep multiple moving parts visible.
• Ability to build working relationships across multidisciplinary teams, including people in technical, product and writing roles.
• Professional working proficiency in English.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role. ILIAS Solutions supports candidates through the clearance process and is glad to explain what is involved before you apply.
If you meet most of the above, we encourage you to apply. The eligibility requirement for the required security authorisation is not flexible.

Nice to have

• PSM I or CSM certification, if you already hold one, great; if not, that is fine.
• Hands-on experience in a Spotify-inspired organisation with Squads, Chapters and Tribes.
• Exposure to Agile metrics and structured retrospective or improvement practices.
• Familiarity with tools like Jira or comparable Agile board software.

jobs.occupation: Test Analyst | Manual Testing | API Testing | Postman | Diegem | Hybrid
jobs.description:
Opportunity

Ensure the quality and reliability of our Defense Platform which offers a complete in-service support lifecycle for materials, consumables, and repairable items within defense organizations.You focus on validating Enterprise Suite functionalities, testing APIs, and ensuring that systems behave as expected in environments where quality and reliability matter.Meaningful Work in a Mission Driven EnvironmentYour work supports applications used in operational environments. You ensure that functionality, integrations, and business processes are reliable, consistent, and ready to support users and operational activities.The Impact You Help CreateYou improve application quality, reduce risk, and ensure that business-critical systems perform reliably. Your work supports consistent and trustworthy outcomes.

Your Mission

What you will do:

• Design, execute, and maintain detailed test plans and test cases covering functional and non-functional testing
• Perform API testing
• Perform integration, regression, and end-to-end testing activities
• Identify, document, and track defects
• Support test documentation and reporting
• Work with development teams to resolve issues and improve quality
• Contribute to structured testing processes and continuous improvement
• Support automated testing activities

What You Bring

• Experience in manual and functional testing
• Strong experience with API testing
• Proven experience using Postman
• Understanding of testing methodologies (ISTQB foundation level or similar knowledge)
• Experience with test and defect management tools such as Jira, Spira, Xray, or similar
• Knowledge of test automation tools such as Playwright or equivalent
• Analytical mindset and attention to detail
• Strong communication skills in English
• Ability to work independently and within a team
Systems Thinking and Analytical StrengthYou understand how business processes, application functionality, APIs, and system behavior connect. You analyze outcomes and ensure that applications perform consistently across scenarios.Working Across Teams and FunctionsYou work with developers, analysts, and others stakeholders. You support collaboration and ensure that quality is maintained across the development process.

Opportunity

This is an office-based role. Candidates are expected to work from our office at least 4 days per week. Remote work is limited to 1 day per week.

Building reliable infrastructure from the inside

Reliable infrastructure is about more than keeping systems running. It means understanding how an environment works, solving problems at their source and creating systems that become easier to manage over time.As a System Engineer at ILIAS Solutions, you take ownership of the infrastructure behind our international organization. This is an internal IT position: you will not work directly with customers, but you will support the people who build, deliver, implement and support the ILIAS Defense Platform.You work across Linux systems, hybrid infrastructure and automation. Alongside day-to-day operations, you look for patterns: where recurring work can be automated, where configurations can become more consistent and where better documentation can make the environment easier to understand. The goal is clear: continue moving infrastructure from reactive support towards a structured, automated and predictable engineering environment.

Meaningful work

ILIAS develops software for demanding defense and security environments, and the people behind that work depend on reliable technology every day. As part of Internal IT, your impact is internal but reaches across the organization: you help create the technical foundation that enables development teams to build, implementation teams to deliver and support teams to help customers. When infrastructure is stable, secure and well managed, colleagues across Belgium, the Netherlands, Denmark and the United States can work with fewer disruptions and greater confidence.

Your Mission

What will you do?

• Manage and improve the internal server infrastructure that supports ILIAS employees across offices, teams and business functions.
• Take ownership of Linux system administration, including installation, configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, patching and performance follow-up.
• Use Ansible to automate recurring work, standardize configurations and make infrastructure changes repeatable, traceable and less dependent on manual execution.
• Maintain Linux and Windows Server environments across VMware, Azure and on-premises infrastructure.
• Investigate complex infrastructure, system, software and network issues with an analytical mindset and a focus on sustainable solutions, not quick fixes only.
• Contribute to clear documentation, monitoring, backup routines, operational procedures and continuous improvement of internal IT processes.
• Support secure and reliable access to the internal systems and infrastructure services used by ILIAS colleagues every day.
• Work with the reliability, quality and security awareness expected from a company active in the defence domain and certified according to ISO 9001 and Cyber Essentials.
 

What you bring?

• Proven experience as a Linux System Administrator or System Engineer.
• Strong hands-on expertise in Linux server environments. Linux is not a side topic in this role; it is one of the core areas where we need depth.
• Solid experience with Ansible, including playbooks, automation and configuration management.
• Good knowledge of Azure and experience with cloud or hybrid infrastructure environments.
• Knowledge of VMware and Windows Server environments.
• A security-minded approach to infrastructure and operations.
• Strong analytical thinking skills: you can investigate issues thoroughly, identify root causes and explain your reasoning clearly.
• A predictable and transparent way of working: you document what you do, communicate clearly and keep colleagues informed before, during and after changes.
• The maturity to take ownership, challenge unclear requests, ask the right questions and work towards sustainable improvements.
• A degree in IT, Computer Science or equivalent experience.
• At least C1 level in Dutch and English.

Opportunity
Ensure the quality and reliability of our PLUS Platform .PLUS exists so ILIAS can focus on its core business. We take on the opportunities, challenges, and initiatives that require new thinking, new technology, or a different approach. By carrying part of the innovation, transformation, and operational load, we help the organisation move faster and prepare for what comes next. Adaptability is our superpower. We don't just respond to change, we work where ILIAS will be tomorrow.You focus on validating PLUS functionalities and ensuring that systems behave as expected in environments where quality and reliability matter.Meaningful Work in a Mission Driven EnvironmentYour work supports applications used in operational environments. You ensure that functionality, integrations, and business processes are reliable, consistent, and ready to support users and operational activities.The Impact You Help CreateYou improve application quality, reduce risk, and ensure that business-critical systems perform reliably. Your work supports consistent and trustworthy outcomes.
